checks.name: ABP startup, six scoped roles and owner capability switching
Authenticated SignalR rejects anonymous, cross-workspace subscription and client publishing
RFQ and versioned quote retain original transactional inventory workflow
Per-line preparation validates quantities, roles and stale versions; commit emits live notice
Dispatcher assignment isolates driver manifests and pickup requires complete preparation
GPS requires active assignment and consent; stale, future and reordered fixes are rejected
Receipt challenge binds merchant, assigned driver, order version, quantities and one-time use
Cash tender and change are explicit, bounded and idempotent; finance reconciles separately
Refused units enter quarantine and warehouse inspection is explicitly separate
